description: Cartografía Temática de Extremadura. I-01_Estaciones GNSS is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sitex.gobex.es. DESCRIPTION: The REP is an open, public and free service that allows centimeter precision positioning in real time or post-processing to any brand of receivers on the market, using GNSS receivers (with any constellation, GPS; GLONASS; Galileo, …) and an Internet connection via mobile telephony. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Thematic Mapping of Extremadura. I-01_GNSS Stations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Temáticos IDEEX. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
